bagPolicy.summary: Bags larger than 12x12x12 inches are prohibited, and large bags must go through an x-ray scanner. Medical and parenting bags are allowed but subject to additional search.
prohibited: Bags larger than 12x12x12 inches without x-ray
bagPolicy.note: Medical and parenting bags exceeding size limits are permitted but subject to additional search procedures.

parking.note: Parking is available at various lots and garages around Amalie Arena, with card payments only. It's recommended to purchase parking in advance via ParkWhiz.com. The Pam Iorio Parking Garage is noted for ADA accessibility.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Amalie Arena's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Amalie Arena offers a diverse range of food and drink options, including Asian-inspired dishes, American classics, and Mexican cuisine. Highlights include bao buns, cheesesteak eggrolls, and a variety of craft beers. Special offerings include gluten-free and dairy-free options.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Amalie Arena, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Amalie Arena's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Located on the west side of the arena, the ticket office accepts payment in the form of VISA, MasterCard, and American Express.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Amalie Arena. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
